alsoTry.name: Omasake
alsoTry.note: The sake izakaya in the same building, with small plates to share by Tomoyuki Yoshinaga; Tuesday to Saturday evenings

bookingOpens: Online through Zenchef from the restaurant's website (preferred), or by phone or email (contact@sushiyoshinaga.com).
cancellation: A card guarantee is taken for every booking. Bookings can be changed or cancelled up to 72 hours ahead; after that the charge is €360 per person.
duration: About two hours. Guests more than 15 minutes late may not be served the whole menu, and the 7pm sitting must leave by 9.15pm.
